name: Zeke
description: XP system! Kill enemies for orbs, earn powers at 5 XP then 10, 15, 20... Three random powers: Speed Boost, Shield Wall, Triple Shot. Stopwatch + stats screen!

name: Zeke
description: Fire posts! Shoot the flaming torches for loot: 50% chance of 1 XP, 20% chance of 3 XP, 10% chance of 5 XP, or 20% chance of a healing heart!

name: Zeke
description: Jump! Press Y or J to leap into the air and fly over enemies. You cast a shadow on the ground while airborne!

name: Zeke
description: Upgradeable powers! Each time you get the same power it levels up: Speed gets faster, Shield lasts longer, Triple Shot fires more bullets. Power levels shown on HUD and stats screen!
